dialogOption.texten: 911, what's your emergency?
Hey, I live near the jail, and I think I just saw someone escaping it!
{WHAT DID YOU SEE?}Ok, tell me what you saw sir.
I noticed some men going out through the window by a rope... Like in a movie!
{WHICH PRISON?}Which prison are we talking about sir?
Fox River, at the [[ADDRESS]]
Fox River, at the 702 Jefferson Street.
Fox River, at the 332 Green Drive.
Fox River, at the 85 Second Avenue.
{HOW MANY ESCAPED?}Did you count how many prisoners escaped?
There were four of them!
Where are they now?
I don't know, they drove away quickly, heading north.
{SOMEONE WAITED FOR THEM?}Did they have someone waiting for them?
No, it seemed like they've stolen a car.
{ANYBODY IN THE CAR?}Was there someone in the car?
Yes, the driver... They dragged him out of the car, hit a few times and threw him in the trunk.
{DESCRIBE THE CAR} Did you get a look at the car? Make, model, color that kind of thing.
Well... it was a... a white car, I believe it was sedan. A white sedan.
{POLICE WILL LOOK FOR THEM}Ok, thanks for the call, the police will start looking for them.
{NOT POSSIBLE}That's not possible sir.
I saw it with my own eyes! Who gave you this job? I guess I'll better call the news!
Good luck!
Will you do something with this?

reportElement.texten: A few prisoners escaped from the jail.
The caller recalled 911, got through to another dispatcher who took the report and later filed a complaint on the operator's incompetence.
